svg.title: Statistical diversity comparisons
svg.desc: Forest plot of estimated differences in mean nucleotide diversity with 95% block-bootstrap confidence intervals. Red points have Holm-adjusted p-values below 0.05.
svg.text: Difference in mean nucleotide diversity (A − B; π/site)
Positive values indicate higher diversity for A; negative values indicate higher diversity for B. Intervals reflect alignment-block bootstrap uncertainty.
